name: Youngstown State University
oos_note: Public university. Base undergraduate tuition & fees $11,717 + non-resident 'Affordable Tuition Advantage' surcharge $180/semester = $360/yr, totaling $12,077. Source: YSU Bursar Non-Resident Tuition Surcharge PDF (FY 2027 = 2026-27) and YSU Cost of Attendance page (ysu.edu/coa), which lists $11,717 base + $360 out-of-state surcharge = $12,077.
